observations: The official OpenTinker repository exposes a protected branch feat/sciworld-support at commit f8ef61365e864d098dadc30060acd96c70bd758d.
The same branch listing exposes feature/support-co-evolve and feature/support-co-evolve-v2, which were inspected as additional plausible memory-work surfaces.

feat/sciworld-support contains docs/sciworld_multiturn.md, opentinker/client/sciworld_eval.py, opentinker/client/sciworld_rl.py, opentinker/client/client_config/sciworld_param.yaml, and opentinker/environment/sciworld/{__init__.py,sciworld_game.py,sciworld_server.py}.
The recursive tree has no opentinker/memory_training path.
Commit f8ef61365e864d098dadc30060acd96c70bd758d is dated 2026-03-12T19:38:12Z and has parent 1ebc87e4ffe58b3d75011bfda282f9dc23bf3abf.

The branch path history for opentinker/environment/sciworld includes multiple commits on 2026-03-12, so a public ScienceWorld environment implementation existed in official repository branch history before the Auto-Dreamer arXiv v1 date.

SciWorldGame instantiates ScienceWorldEnv with envStepLimit=max_steps, passes simplification_str to env.load, supports explicit Python random seeding at reset, and records task_name, variation, score and success in step info.
This is useful environment provenance, but by itself does not identify the Auto-Dreamer historical evaluated run.
The branch training config sets num_steps=1000, max_steps=30, max_total_steps=30 and simplification_str=empty string.
Paper Table 6 reports ScienceWorld GRPO training_steps=200, simplifications teleport/openDoors/self-watering pots, and max environment steps per episode=50.
Paper Table 5 separately reports the online ScienceWorld evaluation pool as 660 tasks and --max-agent-steps=100.
Inspected paper_repri, feature/support-co-evolve and feature/support-co-evolve-v2 recursive trees contain no memory_training path.
feature/support-co-evolve-v2 also contains no sciworld path in the inspected tree.
Current GitHub code search returns zero results for the exact filename dreamer_calls.jsonl.
The combined memory_training+dreamer search did not surface an Auto-Dreamer/OpenTinker implementation; returned matches were unrelated repositories.

findings.title: Official OpenTinker has a pre-paper public ScienceWorld branch that narrows the historical source search
findings.observation: The protected feat/sciworld-support branch exposes ScienceWorld client, evaluation, RL, config and environment wrapper files and has March 12, 2026 branch history. This corrects the overly narrow implication from current-main inspection: ScienceWorld support was present publicly in an official non-main branch before Auto-Dreamer v1.
findings.scope_guard: This proves only branch/source availability and chronology. It does not prove the paper evaluated this exact commit or config, and Git commit time is not a run-execution certificate.

findings.title: The public ScienceWorld branch is a precursor, not an exact Auto-Dreamer evaluated-run source/config binding
findings.observation: At f8ef613..., sciworld_param.yaml uses num_steps=1000, max_steps=30 and empty simplification_str, whereas Auto-Dreamer Table 6 reports 200 training steps, max environment steps 50, and non-empty teleport/openDoors/self-watering simplifications. Therefore source-path presence cannot be promoted to paper-run identity without a historical source/config/run manifest.
findings.scope_guard: The mismatch is against the branch's checked default training config; an unlocated historical override or later/private revision could legitimately implement the paper settings.

findings.title: The paper-named memory_training implementation and run-export package remain unresolved on inspected official/public code surfaces
findings.observation: No opentinker/memory_training path was found in inspected current main, feat/sciworld-support, paper_repri, support-co-evolve or support-co-evolve-v2 trees. Current GitHub code indexing also exposes no dreamer_calls.jsonl. The exact memory-training source and historical episodes/per_task/trajectories/dreamer_calls/summary bundle therefore remain unresolved.
findings.scope_guard: Checked-surface negative only. Other historical commits/branches, forks, author mirrors, Hugging Face repositories and unindexed artifacts remain open.

full_autodreamer_causal_replay.reason: A public environment precursor is now source-qualified, but the exact paper-time memory_training implementation, evaluated source/config revision, 660-task episode manifest, historical run exports, checkpoint/rewrite transactions and verifier binding are still not co-bound.
